pattern: Generated cards show the whole object posed in the centre with an even, roomy gap on every side (margin_min of about 0.11 to 0.12, above the real range). The hero is often narrow or small and nothing is cut off by an edge. Real cards move in close, let the object run off a bottom or side edge, and fill the width. Generated scenes also add side props (moon, trees, gravestone) that compete with the hero at thumbnail size.
